subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Hindu Cycle
description: A quick win: understand The Hindu Cycle.

hook.text: In Hinduism, death isn't the end—it's a transition. The soul sheds one body and enters another.

buildup.text: Karma determines the next life. Good actions elevate. Bad actions pull you lower. The cycle repeats.

discovery.text: Yama, the god of death, judges souls. He was the first mortal to die and became lord of the dead.

twist.text: The goal isn't a better rebirth—it's escape from rebirth entirely. Moksha ends the cycle forever.

climax.text: Hindu death is a revolving door, not a destination. The afterlife is just another waiting room.

quiz.question: What is moksha in Hinduism?
options: Liberation from the cycle of rebirth
